_comment: Original family & relationship flavor events. Adult-only romance (all romance events require min_age 18 and, where relevant, an alive partner). Frozen event-schema v2.1, existing kinds only.

events.title: First Date Jitters
events.text: {name} is ten minutes from a first date and has changed outfits four times. The fourth outfit is the same as the first.

choices.label: Go, nerves and all
choices.outcome_text: I went. The nerves dissolved somewhere between the bread basket and the second laugh.

choices.label: Cancel and hide under a blanket
choices.outcome_text: I cancelled. The blanket understood.

events.title: The Anniversary Reservation
events.text: The fancy restaurant has one table left for {name}'s anniversary, and it is either tonight with a sitter, or next month with regrets.

choices.label: Book it ($120)
choices.outcome_text: I booked the table. The couple at the next table applauded the dessert. So did I.

choices.label: Cook at home instead
choices.outcome_text: I cooked. The smoke alarm sang, and it counted as ambience.

events.title: Dinner with the In-Laws
events.text: {name}'s partner's parents are coming to dinner, and they have already mentioned twice that they 'eat early'.

choices.label: Attempt a five-course masterpiece
choices.outcome_text: I cooked for three hours. The in-laws ate at 4:30 and declared it 'interesting'. The partner beamed.

choices.label: Order pizza and own it
choices.outcome_text: Pizza arrived at 4:15 sharp. The in-laws respected the punctuality, if nothing else.

choices.label: Serve water and relentless charm
choices.outcome_text: I served tap water with the confidence of a sommelier. The in-laws were oddly impressed.

events.title: The Thermostat Accord
events.text: {name}'s partner has moved the thermostat again. This is the fifth time this month. Diplomatic channels are strained.

choices.label: Negotiate a treaty
choices.outcome_text: The Treaty of 72 Degrees was signed on the fridge. Both parties celebrated in sweaters.

choices.label: Change it back in secret
choices.outcome_text: I moved it back at 3 a.m. The war continues, silent and eternal.

events.title: Radio at Full Volume
events.text: An old song came on the kitchen radio and {name}'s partner grabbed their hand in the middle of doing dishes.

choices.label: Drop everything and dance
choices.outcome_text: I danced badly and happily. One plate did not make it.

choices.label: Keep scrubbing, but hum along
choices.outcome_text: I hummed. The partner spun with the mop instead. Close enough.

events.title: The Sunday Phone Call
events.text: {name}'s parent called 'just to chat', which means one story, two pieces of advice, and three questions about eating vegetables.

choices.label: Settle in and listen
choices.outcome_text: Ninety minutes later, I had heard about the neighbors, the garden, and one surprisingly useful life lesson.

choices.label: Keep it brief
choices.outcome_text: I kept it to five minutes. The guilt lasted slightly longer.

events.title: The School Play
events.text: {name}'s kid has been cast as 'Tree Number Two' in the school play and has rehearsed the rustling for weeks. The performance is tonight.

choices.label: Front row, flowers, full commitment
choices.outcome_text: Tree Number Two rustled like a professional. I cried a little. The flowers were clutched the whole ride home.

choices.label: Slip into the back row
choices.outcome_text: I watched from the back. Tree Number Two spotted them anyway and rustled twice as hard.

events.title: The Pet Campaign
events.text: The kids have united behind a single cause: a dog. They have made posters. One of the posters has a pie chart.

choices.label: Adopt the dog ($200)
choices.outcome_text: The dog arrived and immediately chose My slipper as its eternal rival. The kids declared it the best day ever.

choices.label: Admire the posters, postpone the dog
choices.outcome_text: I praised the pie chart sincerely. The dog has been moved to 'future negotiations'.

events.title: Game Night Grudge Match
events.text: A family board game night has turned serious. {name}'s sibling controls half the board and has just built a hotel. On properties {name} needs.

choices.label: Trade ruthlessly
choices.outcome_text: I traded like a shark and won. The sibling has demanded a rematch every year since.

choices.label: Let the sibling win, gracefully
choices.outcome_text: I lost on purpose. The sibling's victory dance lasted longer than the game.

events.title: Are We There Yet?
events.text: Hour three of the family road trip. The kids have asked the question eleven times. The destination is still two hundred miles away.

choices.label: Invent car games for three hours
choices.outcome_text: I invented 'spot the weirdest barn'. The kids are undefeated. Everyone arrived oddly happy.

choices.label: Deploy the headphones
choices.outcome_text: I put on headphones. The back seat conducted a drum solo on the seat for two hundred miles.

events.title: The Long Version
events.text: At a family dinner, {name}'s grandkid asks how grandma and grandpa met, and the grandparents exchange a look that means 'the long version'.

choices.label: Tell the whole epic
choices.outcome_text: It took an hour and involved a borrowed suit, a wrong bus, and a pie. The grandkid asked for it again immediately.

choices.label: Give the short version
choices.outcome_text: I gave the thirty-second version. The grandkid sensed there was more and will absolutely ask again.

events.title: The Turkey Incident
events.text: {name} is hosting the holiday dinner and the main dish has just gone from 'golden' to 'archaeological' in four minutes.

choices.label: Pivot to an emergency pizza feast
choices.outcome_text: I ordered six pizzas. The family agreed it was the best holiday dinner in years. The turkey was never spoken of.

choices.label: Serve it anyway with confidence
choices.outcome_text: I declared it 'smoky-style'. Everyone chewed very slowly and complimented the salad.

events.title: The Potato Salad Judge
events.text: At the family reunion, {name} has been appointed judge of the annual potato salad contest, a position of great power and greater danger.

choices.label: Judge with ruthless fairness
choices.outcome_text: I judged honestly. Aunt Mabel's third-place ribbon is already a family legend.

choices.label: Declare a five-way tie
choices.outcome_text: Everyone won. The potato salads, collectively, were adequate. The peace held.

events.title: The Tooth Crisis
events.text: A kid lost a tooth at the worst possible moment: a sleepover, thirty minutes from home. The tooth is in a napkin. The napkin is missing.

choices.label: Drive back and stage a tooth search
choices.outcome_text: I found the napkin under a sleeping bag. The tooth fairy's reputation survived another night.

choices.label: Write the tooth fairy an explanatory note
choices.outcome_text: The note explained everything. The tooth fairy left a slightly smaller payment 'due to irregular circumstances'.

events.title: 3 A.M. Committee Meeting
events.text: The baby is awake. The baby has opinions. {name} is holding the baby and negotiating, badly, for sleep.

choices.label: Rock and sing until dawn
choices.outcome_text: I sang every song known to science. The baby slept at dawn. I did not.

choices.label: Tag the partner in
choices.outcome_text: I slept. The partner handled the committee. Breakfast was slightly tense but fair.

events.title: The Birthday Alarm
events.text: {name}'s phone just flashed: MOM'S BIRTHDAY — TODAY. There are six hours until the family dinner and no gift.

choices.label: Panic-buy something thoughtful ($40)
choices.outcome_text: I found a scarf in her favorite color. The hug lasted a full minute.

choices.label: A handmade card and a big hug
choices.outcome_text: The card had a drawing of the two of them. It went straight on the fridge, front and center.

events.title: The Inherited Lamp
events.text: A relative has left {name} a lamp. It is enormous, it is orange, and the family insists it has 'sentimental value'.

choices.label: Display it proudly
choices.outcome_text: I gave the lamp a place of honor. It grew on everyone, like moss.

choices.label: Donate it quietly
choices.outcome_text: The lamp found a new home. The family asked about it once, and accepted the answer of 'safekeeping'.

events.title: The Group Photo
events.text: The photographer wants 'one nice photo' of the whole family. There are eleven people, two babies, and a dog with boundary issues.

choices.label: Stage-manage the whole shot
choices.outcome_text: I directed like a film auteur. The photo is imperfect and everyone loves it.

choices.label: Let chaos take the photo
choices.outcome_text: The photo features three closed eyes and one escaping dog. It is, everyone agrees, extremely accurate.

events.title: The Snowball Truce
events.text: {name} and a sibling are forty minutes into an escalating snowball engagement. The neighbor's hedge has been declared neutral territory.

choices.label: One last sneaky volley
choices.outcome_text: I landed the final snowball and ran. The truce was signed over hot chocolate, terms undisclosed.

choices.label: Call the truce now
choices.outcome_text: I called the truce with a white flag (a sock). Both sides retired honorably.

events.title: The Report Card Conference
events.text: {name}'s teen has brought home a report card with one A, three Bs, and a grade in gym that can only be described as theoretical.

choices.label: Praise the effort, ignore the gym grade
choices.outcome_text: I celebrated the A. The gym teacher and I have agreed to disagree.

choices.label: Enroll the whole family in jogging
choices.outcome_text: The family jogged twice. The couch has never been more appreciated.

events.title: Call Home Sunday
events.text: It's Sunday, and {name} hasn't called home in a while. The phone sits there, guilting silently.

choices.label: Call, stay on a full hour
choices.outcome_text: I called. There was news about the dog, the roof, and a neighbor's fence. All of it mattered.

choices.label: Send a 'thinking of you' text
choices.outcome_text: I sent a text. Mom replied with nine photos and one recipe. A fair exchange.

events.title: The Calendar Betrayal
events.text: {name}'s partner just said 'happy anniversary' and {name}'s soul briefly left their body, because the date had completely escaped them.

choices.label: Improvise a legendary evening
choices.outcome_text: I produced flowers, a reservation, and a speech in ninety minutes. The partner suspects nothing. Or everything, and loves them anyway.

choices.label: Confess and beg forgiveness
choices.outcome_text: I confessed. The partner forgave them by breakfast, but the story will be told at parties forever.

events.title: The Hard Question, Again
events.text: A kid has asked {name} where babies come from, in front of other adults, at full volume.

choices.label: The accurate, age-appropriate answer
choices.outcome_text: I answered honestly and calmly. The kid asked a follow-up. The adults found sudden interest in their drinks.

choices.label: 'Ask your mother/father'
choices.outcome_text: I deployed the classic deflection. The other parent received the question at 6 a.m. sharp.

events.title: The Favor of Doom
events.text: {name}'s sibling is moving apartments and has asked for help 'for a few hours', which historically means a whole weekend and one broken shelf.

choices.label: Show up with gloves and a truck
choices.outcome_text: I carried a couch up three flights. The sibling owes them one (1) eternal favor.

choices.label: Invent a plausible excuse
choices.outcome_text: I cited a fictional commitment. The shelf, inevitably, broke without them.

events.title: The Sleepover Summit
events.text: A grandkid is having a sleepover at {name}'s place and has announced that bedtime is 'negotiable'.

choices.label: Hold the bedtime line
choices.outcome_text: I held the line. The grandkid fell asleep mid-negotiation. Grandparent victory.

choices.label: Negotiate: one extra hour
choices.outcome_text: An extra hour was granted in exchange for one (1) dishwashing session. The grandkid called it 'the best deal ever'.
